pipeline: generate one raw KIMODO/G1-RP motion per target with kimodo.scripts.web_equivalent_generate
build a line-stroke plus body-default-return target from raw motion and recipe constraints
run one G1 right-arm hinge refit from raw to that target
write manifest/metrics/review artifacts for local prior_viewer review
notes: This default replaces the previous staged FABRIK/lightlock/intermediate G1 line-refit/default-return route.
Raw generation should use the web-equivalent demo interface, not the older constraint runner that produced different results from the web UI.
The final postprocess is one direct G1 hinge refit from raw to target, not a multi-stage staged postprocess.
Do not optimize arbitrary SO(3) right-arm rotations or directly rotate endpoint joint 33.
